question: what is the ceiling on what the delta route could save, and does it pay for itself

corpus.fact_cache: warm -- this is the cost of reindexing after an edit, not a cold build

skips: staging (writing the canonical graph from scratch)

projection.note: the mutation itself is excluded: it scales with the edit, and CanonicalTableCounts reading all eighteen relationship tables in 0.030 s bounds per-table work on this database at about 2 ms

limitations: the delta route has no production caller, so its cost is projected from the steps applyDeltaRoute provably runs, never measured end to end
ApplyCanonicalDelta is not timed here: building a kena-scale delta needs real loader output for kena, and the fixed costs already decide the question
one corpus, one machine, one warm cache; a cold cache moves the language engines from 0.57 s to minutes and makes every ratio here look better than it is
the full pass numbers come from one run with per-event timestamps, not from a distribution
